body:
## Problem

The published v0.77.0 does not provide the full client-by-provider matrix promised by a universal router.

### Gemini CLI against a connected Codex/Claude subscription

With a valid router JWT and an active Codex subscription:

```text
GET /api/gemini/v1beta/models -> 200 {"models":[]}
```

The current Gemini documentation states that `/api/gemini` requires `UPSTREAM_PROVIDER=gemini`. Therefore Gemini CLI cannot consume models from connected Codex or Claude subscriptions, even though `/v1/models` exposes them.

### Cursor CLI

`link-assistant-router with cursor` intentionally rejects the client because no Connect-RPC adapter exists. This makes Cursor the explicit missing member of the advertised agentic CLI matrix.

## Expected behavior

- Every connected subscription contributes its live models to every supported client-facing model-list route, with protocol-appropriate metadata.
- Gemini CLI can generate and stream against Codex, Claude, and Gemini models through its native `generateContent` namespace and one router JWT.
- Cursor CLI can run through an isolated `with cursor` session using a maintained Connect-RPC adapter; model calls and tool loops are translated to the selected connected provider.
- No model is synthesized when its provider is disconnected or its live catalog no longer exposes it.
- Add live end-to-end tests for each client/provider pair, including model listing, text streaming, client tool calls/results, server web tools where supported, errors, cancellation, and multi-turn continuity.
- Documentation and `clients list/doctor` report actual support instead of requiring provider pinning or declaring Cursor unsupported.

This is one compatibility-matrix task: the common requirement is completing missing native client-protocol adapters and routing them over the same union of connected subscriptions.
title: Complete cross-provider client matrix: Gemini native namespace and Cursor CLI adapter
